mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors reprice future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market health that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months when UNRATE rises >0.3pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) below their 3-month averages indicate broad demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline below 3-month averages, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months), rising borrowing costs suppress corporate investment and equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to near-term economic deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) fall below 50,000 jobs, it indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending confidence and corporate revenue growth, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of months when PAYEMS < 50.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below their 6-month moving averages indicate accelerating demand destruction that triggers short-term equity volatility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline below 6-month averages, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply chain disruption regimes (INDPRO declining for two consecutive months), reduced manufacturing output increases input costs and profit margin compression, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of supply chain disruption periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
